top_signals.title: Australia’s Household Spending Is Flat as Outlays for Sport Slip
top_signals.summary: Australia’s household spending was flat in August, suggesting a weakening of demand in the economy as the Reserve Bank is expected to resume raising interest rates later today.

top_signals.title: Indian Drugmaker Taps Private Credit for Japanese Acquisition
top_signals.summary: Indian drugmaker Gujarat Themis Biosyn Ltd. has obtained private credit funding to back its purchase of Japanese peer MicroBiopharm Japan Co., highlighting the growing use of such debt for overseas expansion in Asia.
